mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over the preceding 3 months in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 7.5% signals a strengthening labor market, prompting central banks to ease monetary policy and generating positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 7.5% in a month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 7.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic activity, reducing risk premiums and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase by >2% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising >2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, low FEDFUNDS rates and rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) create a risk-off environment, but persistent monetary accommodation reduces equity risk premiums, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods defined by FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Decreasing unemployment (UNRATE) and growing payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market recovery, prompting central banks to ease policy and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both UNRATE and PAYEMS decrease by >0.5% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE and PAYEMS both declining >0.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO above 98.5 signals robust supply-side activity, reducing production costs and boosting corporate profits, generating positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive despite INDPRO exceeding 98.5 in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS rates coupled with falling UNRATE signals accommodative monetary policy and labor market strength, reducing risk premiums and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls by >1% and UNRATE falls by >0.2% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS falling >1% and UNRATE falling >0.2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high INDPRO values indicate robust supply-side activity, lowering production costs and boosting corporate earnings, which drive positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO remaining above 98.5 over the 60-day period.
